title: 第21章 刀背巨鳄第22章 飞流剑法
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
李天命发现，姜妃棂给他指引的方向，不只是神源之路这么简单。
这一路上凶兽蛰伏，毒虫遍布，但也正说明这里是灵气汇聚之地，灵粹生长之地。
火绫山温度很高，常年经受烈日直射，其中草木吸收太阳灵气，所孕养能成的灵粹多数乃火焰灵气。
所以，这里简直是永恒炼狱凤凰的天堂。
往后十天时间，李天命一直往这个方向走，神源暂时没找到，但是拥有橙色天纹的灵粹倒是找到了不少。
比如火灵芝就有三株，此乃还有‘火焚果’、‘流焰叶’等拥有橙色天纹的灵粹。
李天命他们一边寻找神源，一边生吃灵粹修炼，在这样的福地里虽然危险潜藏，不时就有凶兽袭击，但收效也相当巨大。
离开青公主和姜妃棂后的第十天，他和小黄鸡突破到了兽脉境第六重。
在境界上，已经超越了李雪娇，接近追上立李紫峰了。
“这等修炼速度，确实快得匪夷所思，想当年我从开始修炼到兽脉境第六重，花了数年时间。”
李天命心生感慨，这一切来自永恒炼狱凤凰，这也说明永恒炼狱凤凰和四翼金翅大鹏鸟的根本区别。
“第二颗蛋，目前还在颤动，不过这小家伙有点偷懒，现在都不孵化出来。”
李天命时刻观察着伴生空间之内的动静。
小黄鸡都这么强了，他对这第二个太古混沌巨兽，当然充满了期待。
“这几天时间，清灵草找到了不少。”
清灵草其实不算多珍贵的灵粹，他已经深入火绫山了，在这火绫山深处清灵草比较常见，李天命采摘有三十多株，细心包好。
“这次出门很长时间，清灵草已经找好了，再找一下神源就回去。”
因为小黄鸡表现出了十分渴望这神源的态度，所以李天命决定再于这火绫山坚持一段时间。
“棂儿既然给我指引这个方向，那说明只要我走下去，一定能找到一处神源藏身的特殊之地！”
那是个神妙的女孩，李天命对她有百分百的信心。

就在突破到兽脉境第六重的第二天，李天命的眼前出现了一面湖泊。
这是一处高峰峰顶的湖泊，乃是整个火绫山的灵气汇聚之地。
站在这湖泊之前，可以看到湖面上腾腾冒着热气，伸手尝试了一下，这湖泊的水温非常高，若是没有修炼的常人下去，估计皮肤都会被烫伤。
这样特殊的湖泊，正好卡在姜妃棂指引的方向里，这是李天命这一路所行最特殊之处，所以他决定潜下去看看。
“小心点，我能感觉到，这里面肯定有可怕的东西。
就算神源在这里，那也一定会有考验。”
“胆小鬼，啧啧，什么时候你才能和爷一样神勇。”
小黄鸡鄙夷道。
事实证明它在吹牛，刚潜下这灼热的温泉，它就躲到了李天命的怀里，只敢冒出一个头，紧张兮兮的看着外面。
湖水有点浑浊，所以很难看清楚湖底的情况，但李天命惊喜的发现，他左臂掌心的那颗眼睛视线却非常透彻。
哪怕湖水里杂物众多，这颗眼睛都能看得非常清楚。
说实话，若是把缠绕的布条拿开，可以看到他现在的左臂非常帅气，让他原本儒雅的气质，加了三分霸道和妖异。
他右手再拿一柄血火刺，行走黑夜，更像是灵魂收割者。
此刻他已经潜入到了湖底，湖底温度更高，很多岩石都已经烧红了，说明这湖泊底下应该有岩浆地脉，怪不得周围火焰灵气如此浓郁。
“看得太清楚了。”
他估计其他所有人潜入到这个位置，都没有他的视线清楚，头上的双眼已经一抹黑了，小黄鸡也什么都看不见，但是左臂手掌的眼睛仍然能看清楚湖底的岩石纹路。
content_en:
Li Tianming discovered that the direction Jiang Feiling gave him was not just as simple as the path to the source of the gods.
Fierce beasts are dormant and poisonous insects are everywhere on this road, but this also shows that this is a place where spiritual energy gathers and where spiritual essence grows.
The temperature of Huoling Mountain is very high, and it is exposed to direct sunlight all year round. The vegetation absorbs the solar aura, and most of the spiritual essence that can be nurtured is the flame aura.
Therefore, this place is simply the paradise of the eternal purgatory phoenix.
For the next ten days, Li Tianming kept walking in this direction. He couldn't find the source of the gods yet, but he found a lot of spiritual essence with orange sky patterns.
For example, there are three Fire Ganoderma strains, and there are also spiritual essences with orange sky patterns such as 'Fire Burning Fruit' and 'Flowing Flame Leaf'.
While Li Tianming and the others were searching for the source of the gods, they were eating spiritual essences alive to practice. Although dangers lurked in such a blessed place, and ferocious beasts attacked from time to time, the results were quite huge.
On the tenth day after leaving Princess Qing and Jiang Feiling, he and Little Yellow Chicken broke through to the sixth level of the beast vein realm.
In terms of realm, he has surpassed Li Xuejiao and is close to catching up with Li Zifeng.
"This cultivation speed is indeed incredibly fast. It took me several years to reach the sixth level of the beast vein realm from the beginning."
Li Tianming sighed, all this came from the eternal purgatory phoenix, which also showed the fundamental difference between the eternal purgatory phoenix and the four-winged golden-winged roc.
"The second egg is still shaking, but this little guy is a bit lazy and won't hatch it yet."
Li Tianming always observed the movements in the companion space.
The little yellow chicken is so strong, of course he is full of expectations for this second ancient chaotic beast.
"In the past few days, I have found a lot of Qingling grass."
Qingling grass is actually not a precious spiritual essence. He has gone deep into Huoling Mountain. Qingling grass is relatively common deep in Huoling Mountain. Li Tianming picked more than thirty plants and wrapped them carefully.
"I've been out for a long time this time. I've already found the Qingling grass. I'll go back after searching for the divine source."
Because the little yellow chicken showed great desire for this divine source, Li Tianming decided to stick to Huoling Mountain for a while longer.
"Since Ling'er has guided me in this direction, it means that as long as I go down, I will definitely find a special place where the divine source is hiding!"
That is a wonderful girl, and Li Tianming has 100% confidence in her.
On the second day after breaking through to the sixth level of the beast vein realm, a lake appeared in front of Li Tianming.
This is a lake at the top of a peak, where the spiritual energy of the entire Huoling Mountain gathers.
Standing in front of this lake, you can see the steam rising from the lake. I stretched out my hand and tried it. The water temperature of this lake is very high. If an ordinary person without cultivation goes in, his skin will probably be burned.
Such a special lake happened to be stuck in the direction pointed by Jiang Feiling. This was the most special thing about Li Tianming's journey, so he decided to dive in and take a look.
"Be careful, I can feel that there must be something scary in here.
Even if the divine source is here, there will definitely be a test. "
"Coward, tsk tsk, when will you be as brave as me?"
The little yellow chicken said scornfully.
Facts have proved that it was bragging. As soon as it dived into the scorching hot spring, it hid in Li Tianming's arms. It only dared to stick its head out and looked outside nervously.
The water in the lake was a bit turbid, so it was difficult to see clearly what was going on at the bottom of the lake, but Li Tianming was pleasantly surprised to find that the eye in the palm of his left arm had very clear vision.
Even if there are a lot of debris in the lake, this eye can see very clearly.
To be honest, if you take away the wrapped cloth, you can see that his left arm is very handsome now, which makes his originally elegant temperament look domineering and weird.
He holds a blood-fire thorn in his right hand and walks through the night, more like a soul reaper.
At this moment, he has dived to the bottom of the lake. The temperature at the bottom of the lake is higher and many rocks have burned red, indicating that there should be magma under the lake.Earth veins, no wonder the surrounding flame aura is so strong.
"It's so clear."
He estimated that everyone else who had sneaked into this position could not see as clearly as he did. The eyes on his head had gone dark, and the little yellow chicken could not see anything, but the eyes on the palm of his left arm could still clearly see the rock patterns on the bottom of the lake.
